newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares soar as European euphoria remains.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares soar as European euphoria remains.

text.p: 0905 GMT - Italian shares around one percent higher and sitting close to all-time highs as optimism over European convergence sweeps Italian markets higher.
*Brokers note plenty of genuine cash bids from foreign investors but market also being driven by derivatives trading.
*June Fib30 futures contract was first to take off today, opening at record high 19,785 then continued its way higher to peak at 19940.
*Blue-chip Mib30 +0.99 pct at 19807 having hit 19925 while all-share Mibtel 0.87 pct up at 13042 following peak of 13108.
*Volume nearly hour after start was 550 billion lire.

*Market continuing rally of yesterday, helped by option expiries on Friday and gains on Italian bond markets. Overall industrial, insurance and banking stocks all gaining. "There's interest across the whole Mib30," one broker said.
*Credito Italiano remains in favour, up 2.54 pct at 3070 while BCI also strong 0.76 pct up at 3600.
*Only major stock to buck trend is Olivetti after Wednesday's shareholders' meeting. Group expects to make loss in 1997, cumulative losses mean it must reduce capital.
*Energy group ENI says in prospectus for third tranche it expects 1997 net profits to improve on 1996.
